_about: my-win-kit settings shared by every PC. Edited by hand in the repo; every PC reads it from GitHub at start-up (the menu only shows it). autoInstallEssentials (was autoInstallPwsh): the loader installs the essentials without asking: PowerShell 7, Windows Terminal, Claude Code CLI, CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font, the Terminal settings from terminal.json and Terminal as the default terminal app. elevateAtStart: the loader asks for administrator rights once at start (one UAC prompt), so no installer asks again. A PC can override both in Settings (stored locally).
